name: 無底板頁首列＋標誌左、導覽置中，下拉子選單，手機右側抽屜
desc: 沒有底板的整列頁首，標誌在左、導覽連結在畫面水平置中，跟著頁面捲走；手機版改為從右側滑入的抽屜選單。
prompt: 建立一個橫跨整個畫面寬的頁首列，跟著頁面捲動，不固定。頁首沒有底板，標誌與導覽連結各自直接放在頁面上。標誌在左，導覽連結置中，功能區在右，所有元素垂直置中排成一列；標誌對齊頁面內容寬度的左側，導覽連結以整個畫面寬為準水平置中，約佔畫面寬的一半。功能區可放主要按鈕或圖示按鈕，沒有時省略，其他元素的位置不變。導覽項目有子項目時，項目旁有向下的展開符號，滑過後在該項目下方展開一欄子連結。
mobile: 頁首上只留標誌在左、選單按鈕在右，同樣沒有底板，跟著頁面捲動、不固定；導覽連結與功能區收進選單面板：點選單按鈕後，選單面板從畫面右側滑入，約佔畫面寬的四分之三、高度佔滿畫面，左側露出頁面；面板右上角有關閉按鈕；導覽連結在面板裡直向排列並靠左，有子項目時子連結縮排列在該項目下方；功能區放在導覽連結下方，沒有時省略。滑過展開的子選單在觸控裝置上取消，改為在面板內列出子連結。

en.name: Bare header bar with logo left, centered navigation, dropdown submenu and right-side drawer on mobile
en.desc: A full-width header with no backing panel, the logo on the left and the navigation links centered in the viewport, scrolling away with the page; on mobile it becomes a drawer menu sliding in from the right.
en.prompt: Create a header bar spanning the full width of the viewport, which scrolls away with the page. The header has no backing panel; the logo and the navigation links sit directly on the page. Place the logo on the left, the navigation links centered and the actions group on the right, all vertically centered in one row; the logo aligns with the left side of the page content width, and the navigation links are centered horizontally relative to the full viewport width, taking up about half of it. Optionally place a primary button or icon buttons in the actions group; omit it when there is no content, without changing the position of the other elements. When a navigation item has sub-items, it shows a downward expand symbol, and hovering it opens a single column of sub-links below that item.
en.tablet: The tablet layout follows the mobile layout.
en.mobile: Only the logo on the left and a menu button on the right stay in the header, still with no backing panel, scrolling away with the page; the navigation links and the actions group move into the menu panel: tapping the menu button slides the menu panel in from the right side of the viewport, about three quarters of the viewport width and the full viewport height, leaving the page visible on the left; a close button sits at the top-right corner of the panel; the navigation links are stacked vertically and left-aligned in the panel, and sub-links of an item with sub-items are listed indented below it; the actions group sits below the navigation links, omitted when there is no content. The hover submenu is removed on touch devices; the sub-links are listed inside the panel instead.
